enabled.description: A calendar turned off is neither shown nor written.

space.description: Moves the project with its tasks.

schema.description: Prague local time, `2026-10-22T09:00`: only tasks changed since then.

space.description: Ignored with a project, which decides the space.

status.description: `todo` when the owner asks, `inbox` when an agent proposes the work on its own.

body.description: Only the owner changes the brief.

comment.description: Appended to the task's log in the same write. A move to `blocked` or `review` needs one.

link.description: A URL to the output, if there is one.

end.description: For an all-day event, the midnight after its last day.

copyOf.description: The original a copy was written from.
